title: Four Members of MIT Jameel Clinic Named to Clarivate’s 2026 Highly Cited Researchers List
content: Four members of the MIT Jameel Clinic community have been named to Clarivate’s Highly Cited Researchers 2026 list: Regina Barzilay , School of Engineering Distinguished Professor of AI & Health and AI faculty lead of Jameel Clinic; Jim Collins , Termeer Professor of Medical Engineering & Science and Life Sciences faculty lead; board member and collaborator at Massachusetts General Brigham Lecia Sequist ; and McMaster University Assistant Professor and research affiliate Jonathan Stokes . The annual list recognizes 6,802 researchers from more than 1,200 institutions in 62 countries and regions. Clarivate’s Institute for Scientific Information identifies Highly Cited Researchers based on the publication of multiple Highly Cited Papers, which rank in the top 1% by citations for their field and year of publication in the Web of Science Core Collection, over an 11-year window. Those results are then refined through additional quantitative analysis and expert review. Clarivate estimates that Highly Cited Researchers represent roughly 1 in 1,000 scientists and social scientists worldwide. The recognition reflects the influence of Jameel Clinic’s researchers at the intersection of artificial intelligence and health, from AI-driven antibiotic discovery and personalized therapeutics for cancer treatment to the AI-powered risk assessment of breast and lung cancer . This year, Clarivate also emphasized its continued refinement of the selection methodology, including filters designed to address hyper-prolific authorship, excessive self-citation, and anomalous publication and citation patterns. The full Highly Cited Researchers 2026 list is available on Clarivate’s website .
